children: Overview
U.S. energy storage firm's Q4 revenue dropped sharply on residential sales decline
Fiscal 2026 revenue rose 58% yr/yr as company expanded beyond residential markets
Q4 loss widened due to credit losses and inventory obsolescence charges
Outlook
Company expects Pendergrass facility production ramp to begin in Q2 fiscal 2027
NeoVolta aims to convert commercial pipeline into binding orders in fiscal 2027
Company plans to expand Pendergrass capacity toward 8 GWh annually by calendar 2028
Result Drivers
RESIDENTIAL SALES DECLINE - Co said Q4 revenue fell sharply due to reduced residential and installer-channel sales after federal tax law changes
CREDIT LOSSES & INVENTORY CHARGES - Q4 net loss increased due to $3.9 mln provision for credit losses and $1.1 mln residential inventory obsolescence reserve
COMMERCIAL EXPANSION - Fiscal 2026 revenue growth attributed to expansion beyond residential base into commercial and utility-scale markets
